column1: # node.schema.tsv: per-node keys (nodes/<name>.env). Columns: key | type | required | default | secret | description
# Types: host ipv4 cidr4 serial user size int bool text path enum:a,b list:<type> tz version
# "required" = yes: the build fails if absent. "secret" = yes: the value is never printed or logged.

column6: Hostname of the node (identity.hostname and meta-data local-hostname).
Static management address; must equal an address in the site's network fragments.
udev ID_SERIAL of the disk the installer erases. Matched exactly (no glob characters); zero or two matches abort the install before storage is touched.
udev ID_SERIAL of the persistent data disk. The installer never touches it; the install aborts if it is absent, so a seed cannot run on the wrong machine.
cloud-init instance-id; changing it forces a fresh instance. Environment override allowed.
File holding the crypt password hash (mode <= 0600, caller-owned).
File holding an Ubuntu Pro token; absent means no Pro attachment. UBUNTU_PRO_TOKEN in the environment is also accepted.
